product_metadata.title: SEEYE Blackout Roller Shades - Blinds for Door Waterproof Shades for Windows Room Darkening Commercial Blinds for Bathroom Bedroom Office, Easy to Install 24" W x 79" H - 1 Pack, Grey
features: Room Darkening - Blackout polyester fabric and PVC coating of roller blinds provide good shading ability, can block 100% of sunlight to ensure your privacy when you are at home or work

Widely Used - 79" length roller shades can be used on most French doors or glass doors. The waterproof fabric is more suitable for bathroom and kitchen. It is also a good idea for interior office as commercial blinds

Installation - You can use the inside mount to install blackout blinds into the window frame, or the outside mount to cover the entire window. Our window shades can install without drilling, but only for casement windows

Safety Upgrade - We offer a rope tensioner of door blind to prevent accidental injury to your kid or pet. The thick fabric also provides UV protection, balances temperature and noise, and flame retardant
Size - 24" W x 79" H - 1 pack, height adjustable from 0 to 79" by chain. Due to the hardware, the width of the fabric is 1.5" smaller than the total width. That is, the fabric width is 22.5"
